newsitem.title: USA: Premark earnings growth aided by Wilsonart unit.
newsitem.headline: Premark earnings growth aided by Wilsonart unit.

text.p: Premark International Inc. Friday reported higher fourth quarter earnings, aided by strength of its Wilsonart business and reduced net interest expenses.
The Deerfield, Ill.-based diversified manufacturer said earnings also reflected improvements at Florida Tile, as well as increases in the West Bend and Precor businesses.

These factors more than offset temporary disruptions in the U.S. operations of the food equipment group due to recent manufacturing realignments, as well as the continuing impact of soft European economies.
Premark said fourth quarter earnings rose to $32 million, or 48 cents a share, on revenues of $610 million. A year earlier it earned $21.6 million, or 34 cents a share, on revenues of $598.5 million.
For the year, Premark earned $56.7 million, or 87 cents a share, compared with $78.9 million, or $1.24 a share, in 1995. Revenues rose to $2.27 billion from $2.21 billion in 1995.
Premark stock was unchanged at $21.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in morning trading.
